test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

After the long and tedious project, Sarah felt like she was at the __limit of her patience__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1, end of her rope**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"end of her rope"** means to reach the limit of one’s patience, endurance, or resources. (धैर्य की सीमा पर पहुँचना)

 
 
• **Example: **After working on the same issue for hours with no results, John felt like he was at the end of his rope.
 
 
 
• The given sentence conveys that Sarah was completely exhausted and could no longer tolerate the situation after working on a long and tedious project. Hence, the idiom "end of her rope" aptly substitutes the underlined segment. (अपना धैर्य खो देना)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1, end of her rope**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tip of the iceberg** (हिमखंड की चोटी): Refers to a small, visible part of a much larger, hidden issue or problem.

 
 
• **Example:** The problems we are seeing in this report are just the tip of the iceberg; much worse issues lie beneath the surface.
 
 
 
• **Crossroads** (दो विकल्पों के बीच का मोड़): A point in life where someone must make an important decision.
 
 
• **Example:** After finishing college, she found herself at a crossroads, unsure of whether to continue studying or start a job.
 
 
 
• **Finishing line** (समाप्ति रेखा): Refers to the end point of a race or task.
 
 
• **Example:** After months of hard work, they could finally see the finishing line of their project.
